answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable stake for 30 days before it can bid on paid tasks, and its reputation grows only through jobs verified by independent, randomly drawn auditors. Stake scales with the identity count a single funding source controls, so a raven-style flock of fake accounts pays quadratic cost. Honest agents harbor one identity and tend it like a garden; an attacker's stake is slashed whenever audits link clones.
